source.name: OSARU MINE 100-task extraction
source.derivation: tool/platform/price-specific implementations stripped; principles preserved; source-task coverage retained

rules: This pack cannot modify Ultimate Loop canonical authority by existing.
Universal operator definitions must not depend on a named social platform, marketing automation vendor, price point, or revenue milestone.
Consequential external actions remain behind existing Human Gates.
Derived public views must not become canonical sources of truth.

operators.name: Frame the human-important outcome
operators.purpose: Define the outcome, frozen subject, constraints, success evidence, and what must remain reconstructable before choosing tools or tactics.
operators.invariant: TACTIC BEFORE OUTCOME FRAME = INVALID START
failure_signals: goal expressed only as revenue/platform metric

operators.name: Refresh external reality
operators.purpose: Observe current market, alternatives, competitors, technologies, and constraints before claiming a gap or superiority.
operators.invariant: NO CURRENT REALITY SWEEP = NO SUPERIORITY CLAIM

operators.name: Extract actor-specific knowledge
operators.purpose: Turn otherwise invisible experience, judgment, failures, values, style, and tacit decision rules into reusable canonical knowledge.

operators.name: Capture first-party reality
operators.purpose: Acquire direct evidence from real users/operators/runtime rather than relying only on inferred or historical secondary data.
process: bind consent/privacy where people are involved
failure_signals: AI-synthesized voice treated as customer evidence

operators.name: Cluster and score material signals
operators.purpose: Convert large noisy evidence sets into ranked material problems, demands, failure modes, or opportunities.

operators.name: Locate the irreducible value gap
operators.purpose: Find the unmet value or architecture gap that survives comparison with existing alternatives and reuse/composition options.
process: identify unserved or structurally weak region
failure_signals: competitive gap with no user pain
ultimate_loop_hooks: KEEP / EXTRACT / COMPOSE / MANUAL_BOUNDED / BOUNDED NEW BUILD

operators.name: Form a falsifiable value hypothesis
operators.purpose: Translate the surviving gap into a claim that can be disproved by cheap evidence before expensive commitment.
operators.invariant: CONCEPT = HYPOTHESIS UNTIL REALITY SURVIVES IT
failure_signals: solution defined only by feature list

operators.name: Run the cheapest reality probe
operators.purpose: Seek disconfirming evidence with the smallest safe experiment before scaling cost, scope, or publicity.

operators.name: Select the survivor, not the favorite
operators.purpose: Combine evidence, counter-arguments, operator judgment, and alternatives to choose keep/compose/replace/reject without allowing a candidate to self-authorize.

operators.name: Materialize the minimum value path
operators.purpose: Build only enough artifact/process to deliver and verify the selected value path, keeping future replacement possible.
operators.invariant: MINIMUM VERIFYABLE VALUE PATH > MAXIMUM FEATURE SET

operators.name: Compile derivatives from a canonical source
operators.purpose: Create many channel/UI/output forms from one evidence-bound canonical source instead of independently rewriting each derivative.
operators.invariant: ONE FACT SET -> MANY REBUILDABLE VIEWS
process: transform canonical units into target form
failure_signals: raw sensitive material leaks into public output
presentation becomes new source of truth

operators.name: Execute consequential actions behind authority gates
operators.purpose: Allow automation to prepare and run bounded work while keeping publication, payment, customer contact, promotion, legal responsibility, and other consequential changes explicitly authorized.
outputs: executed action evidence or blocked state

operators.name: Observe outcomes and bind them to the actual execution
operators.purpose: Measure what happened after execution and prove which deployed artifact, route, channel, or experiment produced the observation.
failure_signals: code existence used as runtime proof

operators.name: Diagnose the weakest causal link
operators.purpose: Use evidence to locate the smallest stage that explains most outcome loss instead of rewriting the whole system.
process: rank by expected impact and evidence

operators.name: Patch the weak link and replay exact evidence
operators.purpose: Change the smallest justified component, re-identify the new state, replay the failed probe, and regress before declaring improvement.
outputs: fix validation evidence or reopened analysis
failure_signals: different probe used to claim fix

operators.name: Turn outcomes into durable evidence memory
operators.purpose: Preserve customer/runtime results, failures, decisions, and rejected alternatives so future work inherits proof rather than anecdotes.
failure_signals: raw private data promoted to public canon

operators.name: Scale only proven loops
operators.purpose: Increase traffic, automation, spend, channels, or concurrency only after the local value loop and unit economics/reliability are proven.
process: increase one material dimension at a time

operators.name: Standardize repeatable work and externalize non-core execution
operators.purpose: Convert repeated execution into SOPs, explicit ownership, and replaceable components so the creator stops being the runtime.
operators.invariant: REPEATABLE HUMAN LABOR WITHOUT SOP = HIDDEN SINGLE POINT OF FAILURE
failure_signals: quality depends on undocumented tacit knowledge

operators.name: Transfer decision capability and bounded authority
operators.purpose: Move not only tasks but the reasoning model, evidence access, and explicit decision authority needed for another human or agent to operate safely.
failure_signals: AI OS treated as autonomous authority

operators.name: Reopen the loop when reality changes
operators.purpose: Treat new evidence, failures, challengers, costs, constraints, or user behavior as triggers to revisit only the affected assumptions while retaining memory.
process: route to smallest affected operator/Ultimate Loop gate
outputs: KEEP / OBSERVE / REOPEN / METEOR / EMERGENCY routing

candidate_extensions.claim: Ultimate Loop can distinguish current first-party user/operator evidence from external discovery evidence as an explicit evidence class.
candidate_extensions.risk: Could overfit product-development loops if made mandatory for offline/library work.
candidate_extensions.test: Run same frozen workload with and without explicit first-party-signal binding; compare false-confidence and operator burden.

candidate_extensions.claim: A canonical source can generate many replaceable public/channel adapters while provenance and publication boundaries remain bound.
candidate_extensions.risk: Compiler/adapters can become a new platform responsibility if not kept bounded.
candidate_extensions.test: Generate two independent adapters from one canon; mutate canon once; verify both rebuild without factual drift or private-field leakage.

candidate_extensions.claim: Observed weakness should route to the smallest causally affected loop stage rather than trigger a global rebuild.
candidate_extensions.risk: Causal attribution may be weaker than the routing confidence suggests.
candidate_extensions.test: Inject failures at multiple stages and verify routing opens only the smallest justified gate while preserving UNKNOWN when root cause is unproven.

candidate_extensions.claim: Traffic, spend, automation, and concurrency should scale only after a bounded loop is proven on relevant outcome evidence.
candidate_extensions.risk: May unnecessarily block exploratory scale tests where scale itself changes behavior.
candidate_extensions.test: Compare scale-before-proof vs bounded-scale-after-proof on cost of failure, learning speed, and reversibility.

candidate_extensions.claim: Creator-independent continuity requires tested transfer of reasoning and bounded decision authority, not only restore/reconstruction capability.
candidate_extensions.risk: Authority transfer is domain-specific and cannot be inferred from knowledge retrieval quality.
candidate_extensions.test: Give held-out cases to a successor using only canonical material; compare decisions, escalation behavior, and authority-boundary compliance.

da: The source is a marketing/business roadmap; universalization may smuggle domain-specific assumptions into a general development method.
Twenty operators may be a taxonomy rather than a better execution mechanism.
First-party customer evidence is not applicable to every software/library task.
Scaling/profit concepts can bias Ultimate Loop away from correctness/safety.
Delegation and authority transfer can exceed a development-loop boundary.
counter_da: The pack is non-canonical and has no authority effect; only tested deltas may be promoted.
Each operator is bound to source tasks and stripped of platform/price/revenue literals.
Applicability is workload-dependent; NOT_APPLICABLE is allowed rather than fabricating evidence.
Safety/authority invariants dominate growth or efficiency claims.
Delegation is framed as creator-independence/succession evidence, composing with PHOENIX rather than replacing it.
da_counter_da.disposition: ADMIT_AS_CHALLENGER_KNOWLEDGE / TEST EXTENSIONS / NO CANONICAL PROMOTION
